faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Direct answers to the most common questions about our secret coordination and deliveries.
faq.q1: How do you guarantee the surprise stays 100% secret?
faq.a1: Confidentiality is our top priority. We never mention the surprise when contacting third parties, delivery vehicles are unmarked, and our team coordinates discreetly with your trusted contact or venue staff so the recipient has no idea until the grand reveal.
faq.q2: Which areas do you deliver to?
faq.a2: We deliver across Dukem, Bishoftu, and the East Shewa Zone. We can also coordinate customized surprise setups in Addis Ababa and surrounding towns upon advance request.
faq.q3: Can I customize the cake flavors, flowers, or decorations?
faq.a3: Absolutely. All packages can be tailored to your recipient's tastes. From bespoke cake flavors (chocolate fudge, red velvet, vanilla berry) to custom flower colors, balloon arches, and handwritten calligraphy letters, we curate every detail.
faq.q4: How far in advance should I book, and what deposit is required?
faq.a4: We recommend booking at least 24–48 hours in advance for standard setups, though same-day coordination may be available depending on availability. A 25% deposit secures your date and allows our artisans to begin preparation.

about.intro: We are a boutique surprise planning studio based in Dukem & Bishoftu, curating extraordinary milestone celebrations across East Shewa and Addis Ababa.
about.storySectionTitle: Our Story: The Art of the Unexpected
about.storyParagraph1: Yehidat was born from a simple conviction: love and milestone celebrations deserve grand, breathtaking gestures that catch people completely off guard. Sourcing fresh flowers, custom confectionery, festive decor, and timing a surprise to the exact minute is stressful — especially when you're trying to keep it a secret from the person you live with or coordinating from abroad.
about.storyParagraph2: We stepped in to be your stealth celebration partner. From Lake Bishoftu garden villas to Dukem family homes, our local team orchestrates every single element in complete discretion. You tell us who and when; we handle every secret detail; you take all the heartfelt credit.
about.quoteText: “You tell us who, where, and when. We handle every secret detail. You take all the credit.”
about.pillarsSubtitle: Every celebration we create is grounded in three uncompromising standards of excellence.
about.pillar1Desc: Zero spoilers. Unmarked delivery coordination, discreet vendor communications, and airtight cover stories until the exact moment of reveal.
about.pillar2Desc: Freshly baked artisan cakes, premium florals selected on the day of delivery, custom calligraphy postcards, and precision decor.
about.pillar3Desc: Punctual to the exact minute. We coordinate directly with venues, trusted conspirators, and capture the authentic reaction on high-definition video.
about.presenceSubtitle: Rooted in East Shewa with rapid on-the-ground execution and deep local vendor partnerships.
